tagline: Flip the disks. Get more of your colour. Play the computer, or a friend on the other side.
description:
An eight-by-eight green board. Black and white take turns putting a disk down. Any of the other colour trapped in a straight line between two of yours flip to you. Black goes first. When neither of you can place, the one with more disks wins.

On your own you play a computer that thinks on this device. There is no game server. Pass the phone for two people in the same room, or press Play a friend and send the invite: the same board, live, on two devices. Black sits one side, white the other. Tap a square to place.

An unofficial port of Reversi by Alexander Berson. The computer is the same one that shipped with that game.
